name: Atlantis (STS-125)
about: Atlantis (STS-125) (2009-025A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 2009 May 11. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2009 May 19), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW22); its coordinates are written from memory
